scope: Real ZMK report forwarding through encrypted proprietary radio and USB HID; manual mapped-key bringup, not physical scanning or latency qualification.
host: macOS; preallocated native IOHID collector plus CoreGraphics key state and dedicated TextEdit typing test

profile.report: HKRO6 keyboard and six full 12-bit consumer usages
profile.radio: ARQv5; ten samples per packet, four-packet cumulative ACK window; 150 us keyboard packet guard
profile.security: DTLS 1.2 ECDHE-PSK P-256 ChaCha20-Poly1305 SHA256; wired private pair credentials
profile.vendor_input: metadata frame version 4; all 20 key-payload bytes redacted one-for-one after acceptance

final_receiver_restart.note: Restart discontinuity; not a continuous loss-free capture

final_transmitter_restart.note: Bounded status observation, not measured reconnect latency.

retained_failures.case: 350 us keyboard packet guard; 64 altered records and following catch-up window
retained_failures.corrected_by: 150 us keyboard guard, with repeated full matrix and sustained captures

retained_failures.case: USB registry changed during initial recovery discovery
retained_failures.result: No image copied on failed discovery; bounded read-only retry added, final target guard remains fail-closed

limits: 8 kHz report-state sampling and 125 us USB polling are distinct from changed keyboard reports or physical-key latency
Ten-sample batching can add 1125 us before RF; no 125 us scan-to-host claim
Physical MX/EC/HE scanning, active media-key actions, mouse/LED/NKRO modes not qualified
Bounded fault injections are not arbitrary interference/jamming or independent security qualification
Outages/re-pairing/reboots intentionally retire pending state and release keys; offline typing is not replayed
Pair secret stored unencrypted; physical debug and wired maintenance trusted; no irreversible security changes
Physical power loss/replug, Windows and host reboot remain unverified
A recovery USB did not enumerate this session; A used guarded SWD while B used uniquely matched signed UF2
Latest B image not fully read over SWD; new capability schema, signed UF2 and software restart checked
USB identifiers/family ID are experimental, not production allocations
